content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity).**

Section 12.4 imposes on us — the Customer — a non-compete that (i) survives 24 months post-term, (ii) covers "any product or service that competes with Vendor," (iii) applies in "any territory," and (iv) expressly captures developing and acquiring. That fails the fallback on every material term (12-month cap, named product, term-only, internal-development/acquisition carve-outs) and lands in walk-away territory on both duration and undefined scope.

It also flatly contradicts Section 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges we have made no exclusivity or non-compete commitment — a conflict cited in the comment to support removal.

Redline validated (ok:true): delete ¶ 12.4, with the narrowed fallback offered in the comment as a fallback discussion point.
